name: Lake View Homestay
description: A cozy homestay run by a local family, minutes from Mysore Palace, with home-cooked South Indian meals included.

name: Mysore Palace Heritage Walk
description: A verified local guide leads a 2-hour walking tour through Mysore Palace and the surrounding heritage quarter.

name: Hotel Chamundi Residency
description: Comfortable 3-star hotel in the heart of Mysore, walking distance to major attractions.

name: Chamundi Hills Sunrise Trek
description: Guided sunrise trek up Chamundi Hills with a stop at the Nandi statue and temple.

name: Ocean Breeze Beach Villa
description: Idyllic beachfront villa with private veranda, swaying palm trees, and fresh Goan coastal breakfast.

name: Old Goa Heritage Churches Walk
description: UNESCO World Heritage exploration covering Basilica of Bom Jesus, Se Cathedral, and Latin Quarter stories.

name: Snow Peak Cedar Cottage
description: Traditional wooden cottage nestled amidst deodar pine forests and apple orchards with panoramic snow peak vistas.

name: Solang Valley Paragliding & Trek
description: Thrilling tandem paragliding glide over Solang Valley followed by a guided pine forest trail hike.
